summary.answer: Gets points then rank/rank data and compares the returned rank ruby requirement to the supplied value. Unused returned rank-data values do not change the equality result. Writes processLeagueID and then processingEvent=true only when both supplied structures exist, matchCount>0 and placement matches are complete. No else reset is shown. When the slot exists, sets its league ID to the supplied value, zeroes league-name/subdivision/daily-pool fields, sets performanceValue=-2 and clears matches through the helper. Each write precedes the next; no rollback appears. Starts at 0. Only when the first engine result is positive does it read an expiry and system uint64 time; returns expiry minus now only while now<expiry. Otherwise returns 0.
